title: 怀表机芯至全息星图仪形态演变转场 (FLF2V 首尾端点控制)
description: 首帧为黑曜石展台上的精密机械怀表，尾帧为同透视同焦距下的悬浮发光全息量子星图仪。在潜空间中规划平滑时序演变，彻底消除生硬交叉溶解的渐变融化Bug。
prompt: Seamless metamorphosis transition in a dark studio. The precision mechanical pocket watch movement on the obsidian pedestal smoothly unfolds its gear train, its metallic components dissolving into floating glowing rings and particles, reforming into a holographic quantum astrolabe in the exact same perspective and center anchor.
negative_prompt: cross-dissolve fade, simple opacity blend, blurry double exposure, jump cut, camera sudden shake, flickering, low resolution
transition_control_rules: Strictly maintain perspective angle and optical center anchor between start and end frames
Interpolate intermediate mechanical unfolding and particle fluid motion in latent space
Reject traditional two-layer alpha transparency crossfades

swap_guide.step_1: 准备两张【同透视、同中心锚点、同光影朝向】的起始帧与结束帧图像（如：人物闭眼到睁眼、含苞待放到花朵盛开、毛坯模型到赛博完工态）。
swap_guide.step_2: 将两张图像分别配置到 'first_frame' 与 'last_frame' (或 start_image / end_image)，脚本会自动通过 validate_flf2v_pair 校验尺寸与亮度色偏。
swap_guide.step_3: 在 prompt 中详细描写【中间过渡态的物理演变过程】（例如：'逐层展开'、'融汇为粒子流'、'光脉冲充能'），杜绝仅写两个主体名字。
swap_guide.step_4: 运行生成，享受平滑无断层的潜空间流体演化效果！
